experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5628:- ViTPose visibility 向量不够可靠（AP 相关性仅 0.237）
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5629:- 中间层 visibility modulation 有害（破坏预训练空间结构），但这是 visibility 特有问题
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:5632:- **关键结论**: 不要用 visibility 向量，用原始 pose 热图
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:6943:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:982:experiments/exp108/design.md:17:3. 与 `exp107` 不同，duplicate-aware pruning 在 per-keypoint 层面才可能真正发挥作用，因为 duplicate detection 与 visibility/common-support 是同一层面的结构信息。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:7289:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:2349:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3975:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:268:- **新颖性裁决 + plateau 双确认**：novelty agent 的"路线2=打平/超SOTA"对单分支 pose-part-MaxSim 已**实质不可达**（~48 all-query vs 需 ≥62）。剩可走路线只有 **(1) 机制重组 LoRA↔visibility** 或 **(3) 问题 reframe（common-visible support / reliability-aware matching，CLAUDE.md 钦定方向）**。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:7296:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:2394:experiments/exp110/design.md:15:用 identity-level prototype bank 把 low-visibility keypoints 蒸馏向更完整的 support teacher。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:8044:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2897:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3975:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:268:- **新颖性裁决 + plateau 双确认**：novelty agent 的"路线2=打平/超SOTA"对单分支 pose-part-MaxSim 已**实质不可达**（~48 all-query vs 需 ≥62）。剩可走路线只有 **(1) 机制重组 LoRA↔visibility** 或 **(3) 问题 reframe（common-visible support / reliability-aware matching，CLAUDE.md 钦定方向）**。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:8499:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4742:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3395:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. Foundation-model ReID adaptation is also active: CLIP-ReID and PCL-based CLIP fine-tuning adapt pretrained vision-language models for ReID, and SAGA-ReID specifically argues global CLIP aggregation is fragile under occlusion and moves toward patch/local aggregation. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:8500:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4752:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3424:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. Foundation-model ReID adaptation is also active: CLIP-ReID and PCL-based CLIP fine-tuning adapt pretrained vision-language models for ReID, and SAGA-ReID specifically argues global CLIP aggregation is fragile under occlusion and moves toward patch/local aggregation. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:9640:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8025:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10017:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10049:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3677:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5818:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

(2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10058:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3713:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5953:./reassess/r_3.md:8374:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10081:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3958:experiments/library_167_synthesis.md:34:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10257:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4526:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10339:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1098:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10343:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10462:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8025:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10466:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8029:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10530:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10154:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4211:experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). At inference, low-visibility keypoints pass through unmodified. If the model learns to rely on the support-completed features, the gap could hurt test performance. This is inherent to the design, not a code bug.
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10563:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11839:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:10713:experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:13450:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:39:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply SGFA's pair-wise reliability product to occluded image ReID: when scoring a probe against each gallery candidate, weight each body part's contribution by the product of the part's visibility/confidence in the probe AND in that candidate (recomputed per pair), rather than a single self-visibility mask. This makes a region count only when it is uncorrupted on both sides — directly addressing the occluded-ReID failure where a part visible in the probe but occluded in the gallery still injects noise. The L2-norm-response foreground heuristic also offers a cheap occluder/background suppressor (occluders/background give weaker feature norm than the target body) usable to derive a soft visibility map without a parsing model.",

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:12128:4526:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r3.md:1164:- **M3 visibility 语义 — 已解决**。实测 `pose_dataset.py:380-384` 证实 visibility 是 0-1 score（缺失时 `clip(scores)`），vis_thr=0.3 对 score 合理。注意项目自身 `visibility_binary` 用 0.5（:389），0.3 更宽松（刻意选择，OK，与 `POSE_THRESHOLD=0.3` 对齐）。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r3.md:1183:H1/H2/M1 修对，C1 的 predictor 修对（坍缩**预防**大概率成立），M3/M4 实测确认无误。但 **C1 的 var-reg + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 标定整体错位（目标 1.0 不可达、阈值 0.3 偏高 10×、未掩码）= 新 High**，使"可靠监控坍缩"的修复目标仍未达成；外加 M2（未处理 Medium）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）、H3 数据前置。建议：① var/坍缩监控改到 pre-norm + gvis 掩码的 token、阈值按 1/√C 标定（或换 effective-rank）；② M2 记账或扣重叠；③ smoke 路径防空跑；④ 启动前确认 pose_train.npz。修完做同范围全量三审。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:924:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5370:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:121:- **H3（v1 High，外部数据前置，未在代码内解决）**：combined `pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames`/`visibility[N,17]`/`keypoints[N,17,2]`、取 person-0）仓库内无生成脚本，且 pose_dataset 用的是 per-image npz（格式不同）。`load_pose` 读法对（假设键存在即正确），但**文件不存在脚本就跑不起来**——启动前必须确认/生成。非代码 bug，是硬前置。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:925:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5371:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:132:H1/H2/M1 修对，C1 的 predictor 修对（坍缩**预防**大概率成立），M3/M4 实测确认无误。但 **C1 的 var-reg + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 标定整体错位（目标 1.0 不可达、阈值 0.3 偏高 10×、未掩码）= 新 High**，使"可靠监控坍缩"的修复目标仍未达成；外加 M2（未处理 Medium）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）、H3 数据前置。建议：① var/坍缩监控改到 pre-norm + gvis 掩码的 token、阈值按 1/√C 标定（或换 effective-rank）；② M2 记账或扣重叠；③ smoke 路径防空跑；④ 启动前确认 pose_train.npz。修完做同范围全量三审。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:926:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5372:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:172:- **H3**：combined `pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames`/`visibility[N,17]`/`keypoints[N,17,2]`，取 person-0、坐标为原 crop 像素、visibility 为 0-1 score）仓库内无生成脚本；`filenames` 须与 `bounding_box_train` basename 对齐。缺失/格式不符会在 `np.load` 或 `DataLoader(batch_size=0)` 处**响亮报错（非静默）**，仍属硬运行前置。M3/M4 已于 v2 实测确认（visibility=0-1 score、(x,y) 顺序）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:928:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5442:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:14:Review file experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/psc_jepa_pretrain.py (PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain stage-A, SOLIDER swin_tiny backbone 训练, codex 三审 Round 1/3)。机制: EMA teacher 看 full image→body-part latent tokens; student 看 pose-defined partial view(mask drop_groups 个可见 body group 的图像区域)→在 latent part-token 空间用 predictor 预测被 drop 的 teacher tokens(L_part_jepa cos)+L_visible_anchor+L_union+L_var(VICReg variance hinge std×sqrt(C) gvis掩码)。EMA 更新 teacher。已修: predictor BYOL 防坍缩, ckpt backbone.前缀, semantic_weight 0.2, drop 自适应留≥1可见, var/监控 sqrt(C)标定 healthy约1。全量逐行查: (a)表征坍缩 predictor+var-reg 够吗 teacher 会坍缩吗 (b)坐标系 keypoints 原crop像素 normalize ow,oh→12x4 grid 对吗 (c)swin featmaps self.base(x) 返回 featmaps[B,C,12,4] 4D fwd_tokens out[1]/out[-1] 解析对吗 (d)part_pool einsum/EMA update/predictor reshape 维度/BatchNorm1d 在 B*G batch/数值安全 (e)backbone init_weights+ckpt 往返 load (f)novelty: latent body-part JEPA for occluded ReID continued-pretrain vs PersonMAE/HAP/I-JEPA 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。务实中文。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:2915:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:14:Review file experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/psc_jepa_pretrain.py (PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain stage-A, SOLIDER swin_tiny backbone 训练, codex 三审 Round 2/3, 全量重审与 Round1 同范围)。Round 1 verdict=approve, 已修 Low(smoke 尾批 B<2 加 continue 保护防 predictor BatchNorm1d 报错)。全量逐行重审: (a)表征坍缩 predictor BYOL+var-reg sqrt(C) 够吗 teacher EMA 跟随会坍缩吗 (b)坐标系 keypoints 原crop像素 normalize ow,oh→12x4 grid (c)swin featmaps self.base(x) 返回结构 fwd_tokens 解析 (d)part_pool einsum/EMA/predictor reshape/BatchNorm1d/数值安全 + 确认 B<2 continue 修复正确无副作用 (e)ckpt backbone.前缀往返 (f)novelty stage-A vs PersonMAE/HAP/I-JEPA。逐项 + 任何新问题。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+findings(severity)。务实中文。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:3028:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4076:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6740:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4171:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:8375:    34	库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4339:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3958:experiments/library_167_synthesis.md:34:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4420:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4470:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3851:**Counterfactual Occlusion Data Engine**：用 diffusion/ControlNet 做 ID-consistent pose/view 变体，再用真实 occluder / non-target pedestrian 做可控遮挡干预，生成带精确 mask、body-part visibility、occluder/donor 标签的成对 clean/occluded 数据，训练 backbone 学“目标身份不变、遮挡因子可被抑制”的表示。  
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4472:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3907:**Counterfactual Occlusion Data Engine**：用 diffusion/ControlNet 做 ID-consistent pose/view 变体，再用真实 occluder / non-target pedestrian 做可控遮挡干预，生成带精确 mask、body-part visibility、occluder/donor 标签的成对 clean/occluded 数据，训练 backbone 学“目标身份不变、遮挡因子可被抑制”的表示。  
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4524:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:1303:experiments/decisions.md:1824:**上下文**: `exp110 SCKD` 已完成第一版训练端最小原型。该实验在 `exp030a-eq` 基础上新增 `per-identity / per-keypoint prototype bank`，对 low-visibility keypoint 做蒸馏，除此之外不引入 decoder、rerank 或 backbone 改动。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5350:./experiments/decisions.md:5:**上下文**: Phase 1 (33 个实验) 已充分探索了基于 ViTPose visibility 向量的所有方向。最佳训练端改进仅 +1.4%（GiLt+PCFC）。用户指示放弃 visibility 方向，转向纯 pose heatmap + mmpose 更鲁棒模型。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5352:./experiments/decisions.md:974:**上下文**: 下一阶段准备把 `visibility` 引入当前的 skeleton branch / keypoint pooling 路线。但当前多人图中仍存在一个更基础的问题：`pose_data` 和 branch 侧并没有稳定地区分“crop 中的目标人”和“旁边靠得很近的其他人”。如果先做 visibility，再去解决 target assignment，visibility 语义会被污染，后续所有结论都不可靠。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5353:./experiments/decisions.md:977:1. `visibility` 是 **target-specific** 语义，不是 scene-level 语义
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5354:./experiments/decisions.md:978:2. 只要 target person 还会和邻近人物混淆，`visibility`、`KPP`、`GCN` 都会学脏
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5355:./experiments/decisions.md:979:3. 因此必须先解决 **target assignment**，再做 visibility 融合
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5356:./experiments/decisions.md:981:**决策**: visibility 路线按 5 个阶段推进，严格顺序执行，不跳步。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5395:./experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5715:./experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:194:`pooled_feat` 是 5 个 part_feats 的 visibility-weighted 平均。在 loss_fn 中，`score[0]` 是 `global_cls`，`score[1]` 是 `pooled_cls`，`score[2:]` 是 `part_cls`。所以 `pooled_feat` 被 `pooled_classifier` 分类，但它是 part_feats 的加权平均——这意味着 pooled_classifier 和 part_classifiers 看到的是高度相关但不完全相同的特征分布。这不会导致 bug，但增加了一个冗余的 classifier head。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5774:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:918:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5364:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:57:- **H3 pose_train.npz 前置缺失**：`data/occluded_duke/pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames/visibility/keypoints[17,2]`）本仓无生成脚本、`data/` 下也无任何 npz。需先离线生成，且：文件名须与 `bounding_box_train` basename 对齐、取主 person（person-0）、坐标为原 crop 像素。否则脚本无法运行。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5775:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:919:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5365:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:62:- **M3 visibility 语义未定**：`vis_thr=0.3` 作用于 `visibility`。若它是 COCO `{0,1,2}` flag，则 0.3 会把"标注但被遮挡"(=1) 也算可见 → "可见 group" 含实际被遮部位，破坏机制语义；若是 [0,1] 置信度（`config` 里 `POSE_THRESHOLD=0.3` 暗示是 score）则合理。需确认。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5777:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:922:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5368:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:113:- **M3 visibility 语义 — 已解决**。实测 `pose_dataset.py:380-384` 证实 visibility 是 0-1 score（缺失时 `clip(scores)`），vis_thr=0.3 对 score 合理。注意项目自身 `visibility_binary` 用 0.5（:389），0.3 更宽松（刻意选择，OK，与 `POSE_THRESHOLD=0.3` 对齐）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5778:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:924:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5370:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:121:- **H3（v1 High，外部数据前置，未在代码内解决）**：combined `pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames`/`visibility[N,17]`/`keypoints[N,17,2]`、取 person-0）仓库内无生成脚本，且 pose_dataset 用的是 per-image npz（格式不同）。`load_pose` 读法对（假设键存在即正确），但**文件不存在脚本就跑不起来**——启动前必须确认/生成。非代码 bug，是硬前置。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5779:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:925:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5371:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:132:H1/H2/M1 修对，C1 的 predictor 修对（坍缩**预防**大概率成立），M3/M4 实测确认无误。但 **C1 的 var-reg + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 标定整体错位（目标 1.0 不可达、阈值 0.3 偏高 10×、未掩码）= 新 High**，使"可靠监控坍缩"的修复目标仍未达成；外加 M2（未处理 Medium）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）、H3 数据前置。建议：① var/坍缩监控改到 pre-norm + gvis 掩码的 token、阈值按 1/√C 标定（或换 effective-rank）；② M2 记账或扣重叠；③ smoke 路径防空跑；④ 启动前确认 pose_train.npz。修完做同范围全量三审。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5780:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:926:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5372:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:172:- **H3**：combined `pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames`/`visibility[N,17]`/`keypoints[N,17,2]`，取 person-0、坐标为原 crop 像素、visibility 为 0-1 score）仓库内无生成脚本；`filenames` 须与 `bounding_box_train` basename 对齐。缺失/格式不符会在 `np.load` 或 `DataLoader(batch_size=0)` 处**响亮报错（非静默）**，仍属硬运行前置。M3/M4 已于 v2 实测确认（visibility=0-1 score、(x,y) 顺序）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5781:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:928:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5442:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:14:Review file experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/psc_jepa_pretrain.py (PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain stage-A, SOLIDER swin_tiny backbone 训练, codex 三审 Round 1/3)。机制: EMA teacher 看 full image→body-part latent tokens; student 看 pose-defined partial view(mask drop_groups 个可见 body group 的图像区域)→在 latent part-token 空间用 predictor 预测被 drop 的 teacher tokens(L_part_jepa cos)+L_visible_anchor+L_union+L_var(VICReg variance hinge std×sqrt(C) gvis掩码)。EMA 更新 teacher。已修: predictor BYOL 防坍缩, ckpt backbone.前缀, semantic_weight 0.2, drop 自适应留≥1可见, var/监控 sqrt(C)标定 healthy约1。全量逐行查: (a)表征坍缩 predictor+var-reg 够吗 teacher 会坍缩吗 (b)坐标系 keypoints 原crop像素 normalize ow,oh→12x4 grid 对吗 (c)swin featmaps self.base(x) 返回 featmaps[B,C,12,4] 4D fwd_tokens out[1]/out[-1] 解析对吗 (d)part_pool einsum/EMA update/predictor reshape 维度/BatchNorm1d 在 B*G batch/数值安全 (e)backbone init_weights+ckpt 往返 load (f)novelty: latent body-part JEPA for occluded ReID continued-pretrain vs PersonMAE/HAP/I-JEPA 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。务实中文。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5807:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:984:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5498:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:4462:   121	- **H3（v1 High，外部数据前置，未在代码内解决）**：combined `pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames`/`visibility[N,17]`/`keypoints[N,17,2]`、取 person-0）仓库内无生成脚本，且 pose_dataset 用的是 per-image npz（格式不同）。`load_pose` 读法对（假设键存在即正确），但**文件不存在脚本就跑不起来**——启动前必须确认/生成。非代码 bug，是硬前置。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5808:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:985:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5499:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:4473:   132	H1/H2/M1 修对，C1 的 predictor 修对（坍缩**预防**大概率成立），M3/M4 实测确认无误。但 **C1 的 var-reg + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 标定整体错位（目标 1.0 不可达、阈值 0.3 偏高 10×、未掩码）= 新 High**，使"可靠监控坍缩"的修复目标仍未达成；外加 M2（未处理 Medium）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）、H3 数据前置。建议：① var/坍缩监控改到 pre-norm + gvis 掩码的 token、阈值按 1/√C 标定（或换 effective-rank）；② M2 记账或扣重叠；③ smoke 路径防空跑；④ 启动前确认 pose_train.npz。修完做同范围全量三审。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5809:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:986:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5500:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:4513:   172	- **H3**：combined `pose_train.npz`（键 `filenames`/`visibility[N,17]`/`keypoints[N,17,2]`，取 person-0、坐标为原 crop 像素、visibility 为 0-1 score）仓库内无生成脚本；`filenames` 须与 `bounding_box_train` basename 对齐。缺失/格式不符会在 `np.load` 或 `DataLoader(batch_size=0)` 处**响亮报错（非静默）**，仍属硬运行前置。M3/M4 已于 v2 实测确认（visibility=0-1 score、(x,y) 顺序）。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5810:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:988:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5502:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:4545:    22	2. **data**：**train split only**（防 query/gallery 泄漏）Market+MSMT17+Occluded-Duke+Occluded-ReID+Occluded-PoseTrack；预缓存 pose/keypoint visibility/body-group mask + pose-defined complementary masks。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5831:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:2915:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:14:Review file experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/psc_jepa_pretrain.py (PSC-JEPA continued-pretrain stage-A, SOLIDER swin_tiny backbone 训练, codex 三审 Round 2/3, 全量重审与 Round1 同范围)。Round 1 verdict=approve, 已修 Low(smoke 尾批 B<2 加 continue 保护防 predictor BatchNorm1d 报错)。全量逐行重审: (a)表征坍缩 predictor BYOL+var-reg sqrt(C) 够吗 teacher EMA 跟随会坍缩吗 (b)坐标系 keypoints 原crop像素 normalize ow,oh→12x4 grid (c)swin featmaps self.base(x) 返回结构 fwd_tokens 解析 (d)part_pool einsum/EMA/predictor reshape/BatchNorm1d/数值安全 + 确认 B<2 continue 修复正确无副作用 (e)ckpt backbone.前缀往返 (f)novelty stage-A vs PersonMAE/HAP/I-JEPA。逐项 + 任何新问题。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+findings(severity)。务实中文。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5833:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:3028:./experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:903:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5851:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:3914:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:1864:experiments/library_167_synthesis.md:34:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5853:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4076:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:6740:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5854:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4171:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:8375:    34	库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5856:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4420:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5857:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4470:./experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3851:**Counterfactual Occlusion Data Engine**：用 diffusion/ControlNet 做 ID-consistent pose/view 变体，再用真实 occluder / non-target pedestrian 做可控遮挡干预，生成带精确 mask、body-part visibility、occluder/donor 标签的成对 clean/occluded 数据，训练 backbone 学“目标身份不变、遮挡因子可被抑制”的表示。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5860:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:4539:./experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:3257:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20.sh:6:CTX="一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。"

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5890:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3971:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:203:- **pose-part + 只匹配互见部位：最成熟的轴**。PVPM (CVPR'20) 已有 visibility predictor + 只匹配可见部位；KPR (ECCV'24, SOLIDER/Swin) 是当前最强同款。我们的差异仅 **MaxSim**（ColBERT late-interaction 借来）替代固定 part-to-part 对齐——mechanism 小 delta，不是新问题定义。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5891:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3975:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:268:- **新颖性裁决 + plateau 双确认**：novelty agent 的"路线2=打平/超SOTA"对单分支 pose-part-MaxSim 已**实质不可达**（~48 all-query vs 需 ≥62）。剩可走路线只有 **(1) 机制重组 LoRA↔visibility** 或 **(3) 问题 reframe（common-visible support / reliability-aware matching，CLAUDE.md 钦定方向）**。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5892:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3980:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:389:**唯一幸存 PartNC(Part-level Noisy-Correspondence)**：用部位粒度 image-text 相似度估每个身体部位 clean/noisy 置信(RDE 的 CCD 从 pair 级下沉到部位级)；**真正空白=用 pose-visibility 先验区分"相似度低=遮挡(结构化)"vs"=标注错(随机)"**(RDE/DURA/GA-DMS 把 noise 当随机，表达不出)。复用我们 part-MaxSim 逻辑(einsum bkc,gpc->bgkp .max)+pose 可见性积累。
experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5894:./experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3999:experiments/exp337_swin_lgpa_nopose/claude_review.md:38:- **Low-2（次要）**：no-pose 下 `kp_weights=visibility.detach()` 为均匀 1/5（aux_data, line 299/298）。本实验 equal_concat 不消费该键（line 918 dict 分支不触发），MaxSim 也未开，故无影响。仅记录：若后续切 maxsim 系测试特征，需注意 no-pose 的 kp_weights 退化为均匀。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:5912:./experiments/exp340_swin_lgpa_fixedbands/claude_review.md:56:- **device/缓存**：`_canon_hm_cache` 在 CPU 建一次（`torch.zeros(...)` 默认 CPU），之后每次 `.to(device).expand(...)`。`.to(device)` 对已在该 device 的 tensor 是 no-op（不重复拷贝到同设备），缓存只建一次，正确。注意它是普通属性而非 `register_buffer`，所以 `model.to(device)` / `.half()` 不会动它——但因为每次调用都显式 `.to(device)`，device 始终正确；dtype 恒为 float32，clip_part_head 内 `_compute_pose_bias` / `_compute_gt_assignment` / visibility 都先 `.float()`，与 AMP 下 float16 featmap 的 bias 相加发生在 `_cross_attention_with_pose`：`attn_scores`(来自 featmap，可能 fp16) + `pose_bias.unsqueeze(1)`(fp32) → 触发上采 fp32，再 `clamp(-50,50)` → softmax，无 dtype 崩溃。安全（与 scene 热图路径完全同构，scene 热图本身也是 fp32）。

experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r2.md:6058:./experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/codex_review_r1.md:5371:experiments/exp361_psc_jepa/claude_review.md:132:H1/H2/M1 修对，C1 的 predictor 修对（坍缩**预防**大概率成立），M3/M4 实测确认无误。但 **C1 的 var-reg + tok_std 监控对 L2-normalized token 标定整体错位（目标 1.0 不可达、阈值 0.3 偏高 10×、未掩码）= 新 High**，使"可靠监控坍缩"的修复目标仍未达成；外加 M2（未处理 Medium）、smoke<bs 静默空跑（新 Medium）、H3 数据前置。建议：① var/坍缩监控改到 pre-norm + gvis 掩码的 token、阈值按 1/√C 标定（或换 effective-rank）；② M2 记账或扣重叠；③ smoke 路径防空跑；④ 启动前确认 pose_train.npz。修完做同范围全量三审。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_7.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:73:重定义：大家以为 ReID 输入是“一个人图像”，其实应先判断它是不是“证据充分的身份查询”。新问题不是 occlusion/visibility，而是 **observable identity evidence sufficiency**：这张 crop 里有多少可区分、可跨相机复现的局部证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_14.md:92:机制草案：SAM/pose/DINO 生成 bbox 内 candidate masks/keypoints；SOLIDER 对每个候选 mask/crop 提特征。训练用 MIL/EM：正样本对选择最一致的 candidate pair，负样本要求所有 candidate 都远；加 center/area/detector prior，但不依赖人工 prompt。推理时普通单人 crop 退化为 baseline，多人 crop 做 set-to-set matching。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4211:experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). At inference, low-visibility keypoints pass through unmodified. If the model learns to rely on the support-completed features, the gap could hurt test performance. This is inherent to the design, not a code bug.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train4_final.md:4237:experiments/exp324/design.md:20:2. **pose 锚定 5-part**：用 `pose_data/{query,gallery}/<img>.npz` 的 keypoints(17,2)+visibility，把 17 COCO keypoint 投到 DINO patch grid，按 LGPA 5-part 分组（head / upper-torso+arms / lower-torso / legs / feet 之类，复用 `model/modules/pose_part_pooling.py` 的分组）池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility mask（该 part 有无可见 keypoint）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_15.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:10:- 主损失: ID CE + degraded/original prediction consistency + entropy/margin 校准。**无 contrastive/late-interaction/pooling/prototype/visibility。**

experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2532:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3620:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:24:`kp_w` 来自 `kp_data['kp_weights']`，由 GCN head 根据 `pose_dict` 中的原始 keypoint scores 计算。PLBOA（`_apply_lower_body_occlusion`）**只修改图像像素，不修改 `persons` 数据的 scores**。因此 `kp_w > 0.3` 对所有原始可见 keypoints 都为 True，包括被 PLBOA 遮挡的那些。
experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:26:**影响**: POI loss 会尝试对齐被遮挡 keypoints 处的特征（clean vs occluded），完全违背了"仅对齐可见部分"的核心设计意图。训练集 95.8% 可见意味着几乎所有 17 个 keypoints 都被标记为 visible，POI 退化为全局特征对齐。
experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:28:**修复方案**: 需要在 PLBOA 之后更新 pose_dict 中的 visibility/scores，或在 OERL 中根据 PLBOA 的遮挡区域独立计算哪些 keypoints 被遮挡。例如，保存 PLBOA 的 `occ_start` 坐标，将 y > occ_start 的 keypoints 标记为 occluded。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review_airl.md:17:AIRL = resolution-degradation consistency: ground 图退化到 aerial 像素预算 + 强迫退化版预测==原版 → 学低像素预算下稳定的身份证据。**无 contrastive/late-interaction/pooling/prototype/visibility(避开 OVLI 死区)。** kill-switch #1 PASS(小尺度桶强 Swin 上仍塌 +13~19)后验机制利用。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:4570:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3919:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1976:reassess/r_3.md:4631:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:24:`kp_w` 来自 `kp_data['kp_weights']`，由 GCN head 根据 `pose_dict` 中的原始 keypoint scores 计算。PLBOA（`_apply_lower_body_occlusion`）**只修改图像像素，不修改 `persons` 数据的 scores**。因此 `kp_w > 0.3` 对所有原始可见 keypoints 都为 True，包括被 PLBOA 遮挡的那些。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:4675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4250:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4617:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review_v2.md:18:v1 使用 `kp_data['kp_weights']` 作为可见性判断，而 PLBOA 不修改 scores，导致被遮挡的 keypoints 仍被标记为 visible。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:4676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4251:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4618:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review_v2.md:20:v2 完全重写：不再依赖外部遮挡。使用 `torch.randperm` 随机选择 keypoints 作为 `occ_mask`(line 899-902)，然后 `visible = (~occ_mask) & (kp_scores > 0.3)` (line 923) 正确排除了被遮挡的 keypoints。遮挡是自生成的，不依赖 PLBOA。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:4678:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4253:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4627:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review_v2.md:128:v1 审查指出 design.md 描述了 5 种遮挡模式但实现仅依赖 PLBOA。v2 实现使用 **随机 keypoint 遮挡**（`torch.randperm` 选择 ~50% keypoints），这与 design 中的"随机 40-60% keypoints"模式一致。不再需要 PLBOA 来生成遮挡。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:4680:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:4255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4633:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp217/claude_review.md:28:**修复方案**: 需要在 PLBOA 之后更新 pose_dict 中的 visibility/scores，或在 OERL 中根据 PLBOA 的遮挡区域独立计算哪些 keypoints 被遮挡。例如，保存 PLBOA 的 `occ_start` 坐标，将 y > occ_start 的 keypoints 标记为 occluded。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12139:### [2026-03-23 02:30] 决策 #N: exp148/149/151 结论与训练集 visibility 关键发现
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12146:1. **exp148 PCVT**: 早期加速（ep30 +2.4 mAP），后期被基线追平并反超（ep100 -0.9 mAP）。3-view 训练的 1/3 主损失稀释 + 训练数据缺乏 visibility 多样性。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12150:**选择**: 彻底放弃所有训练时 visibility-dependent 的创新方向。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12153:1. 训练集 95.8% 可见 → 任何依赖训练时 visibility 变化的机制都缺乏信号
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12157:**后续约束**: 不再在训练侧做任何 visibility-conditioned 机制。如果要改善遮挡鲁棒性，只有两条路：(a) 数据增强缩小 train-test visibility gap (b) 改善 test-time matching。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12165:4. **训练集 95.8% 可见**：解释了所有 visibility-dependent 方法的失败。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:12306:**关键洞察**: DPSM 的本质是**用全局特征做局部 token 的置信度评分**，然后动态截断。这比固定的 visibility threshold 更灵活。

experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:31:- 原 npz 2.7G（含 17×64×48 heatmap），2MB/s ProxyJump 传输需数小时 = 卡点。**解法**：在 lab-3090-d 上把 npz 剥成 slim（只留 keypoints+visibility_binary，exp324 实际只用这两个字段），2.7G→113M，18s 生成，几分钟中转完成。hyy 上 dinov2-b 复现 exp324 smoke 数字逐位一致 + heavy-occ 989/2210 与 exp324 完全相同 → **slim 剥离无损，pipeline apples-to-apples**。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:203:- **pose-part + 只匹配互见部位：最成熟的轴**。PVPM (CVPR'20) 已有 visibility predictor + 只匹配可见部位；KPR (ECCV'24, SOLIDER/Swin) 是当前最强同款。我们的差异仅 **MaxSim**（ColBERT late-interaction 借来）替代固定 part-to-part 对齐——mechanism 小 delta，不是新问题定义。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:207:1. **真新机制**：LoRA↔visibility **交互**（pose/visibility-conditioned LoRA，或 per-part low-rank experts 按遮挡 gate），带消融证明——不是"加了 LoRA 加了 parts"。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:268:- **新颖性裁决 + plateau 双确认**：novelty agent 的"路线2=打平/超SOTA"对单分支 pose-part-MaxSim 已**实质不可达**（~48 all-query vs 需 ≥62）。剩可走路线只有 **(1) 机制重组 LoRA↔visibility** 或 **(3) 问题 reframe（common-visible support / reliability-aware matching，CLAUDE.md 钦定方向）**。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:289:- **SAM/SAM2 遮挡 mask**：落入禁止清单 visibility 变体 + KPR 已 human parsing → 增量，不做。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:317:(b) 若要做方法，必须走 **LoRA↔visibility 机制重组** 或 **common-visible-support/reliability 问题 reframe**（CLAUDE.md 钦定方向），不在这条曲线上继续。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:334:- **下一步不是再开 DINO-curve 实验**（CLAUDE.md 铁律：不刷点不堆模块），而是：转 analysis 故事整理，或设计 LoRA↔visibility 机制重组 / common-visible-support·reliability 问题 reframe（CLAUDE.md 钦定方向，需先写设计+红蓝队）。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:389:**唯一幸存 PartNC(Part-level Noisy-Correspondence)**：用部位粒度 image-text 相似度估每个身体部位 clean/noisy 置信(RDE 的 CCD 从 pair 级下沉到部位级)；**真正空白=用 pose-visibility 先验区分"相似度低=遮挡(结构化)"vs"=标注错(随机)"**(RDE/DURA/GA-DMS 把 noise 当随机，表达不出)。复用我们 part-MaxSim 逻辑(einsum bkc,gpc->bgkp .max)+pose 可见性积累。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:424:**砍掉(早借/已死, 负面先验)**：LGPA(text 解耦已建)/FSDC(补全已建+撞墙)/LTCS-LPCS(common-support 判死)/MLS-uncertainty(PartNC 刚死)/adaptive-margin(贴 visibility 证伪)/PACI(sub-center 已建)/conformal(test-time 禁)/counterfactual-attention(PGMA 已有)。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:471:- **为何非已关方向**: 与 visibility 加权**正交**(visibility 问"是否被遮挡"二值; burstiness 问"这个可见特征是否被过度计数"集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty(大块平躯干)——现有方法升权它, burstiness 说降权。非 completion(不重建)、非 scorer 微变体(改特征集聚合)、非 uncertainty(无 per-feature 置信)。**Novelty 已核: 无 occluded-ReID 做 burst-aware/democratic over part/patch 特征**(最近 cousin = Self-similarity guided probabilistic matching ESWA'23 是去噪/校验, 相反符号)。详见 memory [[burstiness-democratic-aggregation-bet]]。
experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:476:- 范式调研同时**否证一批**: gait occlusion-type/residual=已关; CC-ReID 因果换衣=无遮挡 analog 不撞 disentangle; vehicle VANet 两度量=common-support 已死; set/video quality-pool=visibility 已关。诚实负面收窄空间。
experiments/exp329_burstiness/design.md:12:遮挡 ReID 中, 少数**可见但过表达**的区域(大块近匀质躯干 patch、重复背景泄漏纹理)在很多 patch token 上重复出现; 检索对 token 求和/取 max → 这些 bursty token **抬高匹配分却不加身份信息**, 挤掉稀有可辨细节(包带/鞋)。按 self-similarity 反比降权(democratic 聚合)应提升遮挡检索, 且**与 visibility 加权正交**(可见 ≠ 不冗余)。
experiments/exp329_burstiness/design.md:15:- **非 visibility 小变体**: visibility 问"是否被遮挡"(二值/遮挡驱动); burstiness 问"这个**可见**特征是否被过度计数"(可见集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1780:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5549:./reassess/r_2.md:1263:reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2031:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4097:./reassess/r_3.md:2314:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_2.txt:1:结论先说：我会把主线从“怎么对齐航拍-地面”转成“训练标签里的同一身份关系并不等价”。SMPL 不再当身份特征，也不再做 canonical/visibility 对齐，而是当 **可测的几何条件变量**，用来重排训练关系或做因果干预。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2032:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4098:./reassess/r_3.md:2336:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_2.txt:62:先做方向 1。它最贴合当前失败链：不救 avg/MaxSim，不碰 visibility 红海，不再把 SMPL 当身份特征，而且 kill-switch 足够干净。方向 2 作为备选，只有在 surface ACE 非常集中时再推进，否则容易被审稿人归类为“又一个人体区域遮挡增强”。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2162:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4230:./reassess/r_3.md:3115:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:3346:./validate/v_3.md:15189:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7389:./validate/v_3.md:2775:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3980:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:389:**唯一幸存 PartNC(Part-level Noisy-Correspondence)**：用部位粒度 image-text 相似度估每个身体部位 clean/noisy 置信(RDE 的 CCD 从 pair 级下沉到部位级)；**真正空白=用 pose-visibility 先验区分"相似度低=遮挡(结构化)"vs"=标注错(随机)"**(RDE/DURA/GA-DMS 把 noise 当随机，表达不出)。复用我们 part-MaxSim 逻辑(einsum bkc,gpc->bgkp .max)+pose 可见性积累。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2289:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4358:./reassess/r_3.md:4017:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2700:cheap kill-switch：先做训练很轻的辅助头。冻结或半冻结 SOLIDER，在现有数据上预测 SMPL joint visibility、身体表面区域或姿态几何 token，看辅助监督是否能改善跨视角检索。若只学几何 token 不改善，说明几何语义没有进入身份判别，及时停。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2853:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1694:reassess/r_3.md:3743:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3169:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3102:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4153:reassess/r_2.md:993:reassess/r_3.md:1951:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3226:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4279:reassess/r_2.md:1506:reassess/r_3.md:3295:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3254:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4307:reassess/r_2.md:1570:reassess/r_3.md:3430:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2806:cheap kill-switch：不训练新大模型，先用现有 SMPL 或 2D joints 把图像分成若干 canonical 身体区域，用 SOLIDER 特征做 visibility-aware pooling 和距离重加权。若在 AG-ReID 小子集上最后指标没有超过普通全局特征至少 mAP 0.4、rank1 0.5，先杀掉。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3255:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4308:reassess/r_2.md:1572:reassess/r_3.md:3432:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2811:cheap kill-switch：先做纯评测级首验。提取全局特征和按 SMPL 区域聚合的局部特征，对每个 query-gallery 对取可见区域 soft-min 距离或 visibility-penalized 距离。若不训练都没有稳定改善，说明“最优几何距离”信号弱，不继续写复杂损失。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3295:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4348:reassess/r_2.md:1694:reassess/r_3.md:3743:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3169:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3300:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4353:reassess/r_2.md:1705:reassess/r_3.md:3755:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3247:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3335:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4388:reassess/r_2.md:1821:reassess/r_3.md:4017:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2700:cheap kill-switch：先做训练很轻的辅助头。冻结或半冻结 SOLIDER，在现有数据上预测 SMPL joint visibility、身体表面区域或姿态几何 token，看辅助监督是否能改善跨视角检索。若只学几何 token 不改善，说明几何语义没有进入身份判别，及时停。

experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:21:The gate network runs on all keypoints even though only `support_mask` positions contribute. Masked positions get zeroed out by `gate = raw_gate * support_mask.float()`. Functionally correct, minor wasted compute.
experiments/exp127/claude_review.md:31:1. **Train/test distribution gap**: SCRC fusion only runs during training (requires labels + bank). At inference, low-visibility keypoints pass through unmodified. If the model learns to rely on the support-completed features, the gap could hurt test performance. This is inherent to the design, not a code bug.

experiments/exp268_best_s_m_s42/claude_review.md:32:model.eval() 切到推理模式后再调 _extract_feat_flip，BN/Dropout 安全。flip_batch 对 heatmaps/keypoints/scores 做 L-R swap 正确（FLIP_PAIRS 定义在 datasets/pose_dataset.py）。dict feat (cvk/maxsim) 字段级 average，tensor feat 整体 average。
experiments/exp118/design.md:5:exp117 表明 VCGA 在基础配置（exp030a）上完全中性。但 VCGA 的效果可能在更强的基线上更明显——当 PAA 已经改善了多人场景的 backbone 特征，VCGA 对 GCN 的 visibility-conditioned routing 可能更有信息量。
experiments/exp118/design.md:12:- PAA 改善 backbone 特征质量 → GCN 接收的 keypoint features 更好 → VCGA 的 visibility routing 更有效
experiments/exp324b/design.md:19:- **数据流**：图 → 冻结 DINOv2-base dense tokens → 姿态锚定 5 部位池化 + per-part visibility（exp324 已实现）→ **轻量共享线性投影头** 768→512 + BNNeck → 全局特征 = 可见部位投影向量的 masked mean；测试用 mutually-visible part-MaxSim 出 distmat。
experiments/exp356_pcmsc/design.md:17:- **非禁忌**: 不是 visibility gate(禁忌#1), 不是 retrieval scorer, 不进 CLIP 对齐。

experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2433:./experiments/exp237/claude_review.md:194:`pooled_feat` 是 5 个 part_feats 的 visibility-weighted 平均。在 loss_fn 中，`score[0]` 是 `global_cls`，`score[1]` 是 `pooled_cls`，`score[2:]` 是 `part_cls`。所以 `pooled_feat` 被 `pooled_classifier` 分类，但它是 part_feats 的加权平均——这意味着 pooled_classifier 和 part_classifiers 看到的是高度相关但不完全相同的特征分布。这不会导致 bug，但增加了一个冗余的 classifier head。
experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2442:./experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:1181:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3395:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. Foundation-model ReID adaptation is also active: CLIP-ReID and PCL-based CLIP fine-tuning adapt pretrained vision-language models for ReID, and SAGA-ReID specifically argues global CLIP aggregation is fragile under occlusion and moves toward patch/local aggregation. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.
experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3424:Close precedents exist: PVPM already does pose-guided visible part matching for occluded ReID with learned visibility; KPR uses keypoints to disambiguate occluded/multi-person ReID; PFD explicitly matches visible body parts and adds pose-guided part loss. Foundation-model ReID adaptation is also active: CLIP-ReID and PCL-based CLIP fine-tuning adapt pretrained vision-language models for ReID, and SAGA-ReID specifically argues global CLIP aggregation is fragile under occlusion and moves toward patch/local aggregation. DINOv2 itself is positioned as general-purpose frozen visual features.
experiments/exp111/design.md:5:`exp110` 证明了训练端的 `support-complete prototype distillation` 能在单 seed 上转正，但增益仍然偏弱。当前实现里 `POSE_SCKD_MIN_COUNT=1`，意味着某个 identity 的某个 keypoint 只要出现过一次 high-visibility 观测，就会被当作 teacher 使用。这种 teacher 过于宽松，容易把偶然噪声、姿态抽取误差、遮挡下的不稳定局部都写入 bank。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:473:**上下文**: Phase 1 (33 个实验) 已充分探索了基于 ViTPose visibility 向量的所有方向。最佳训练端改进仅 +1.4%（GiLt+PCFC）。用户指示放弃 visibility 方向，转向纯 pose heatmap + mmpose 更鲁棒模型。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1032:experiments/decisions.md:1107:**上下文**: exp148 PCVT 和 exp151 PVAT 全部失败。训练集 95.8% 可见率使得所有 visibility-dependent 训练方法无效。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1033:experiments/decisions.md:1136:### [2026-03-23 02:30] 决策 #N: exp148/149/151 结论与训练集 visibility 关键发现
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1035:experiments/decisions.md:1143:1. **exp148 PCVT**: 早期加速（ep30 +2.4 mAP），后期被基线追平并反超（ep100 -0.9 mAP）。3-view 训练的 1/3 主损失稀释 + 训练数据缺乏 visibility 多样性。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1063:experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:393:2. **exp151 PVAT pvat_acc 不下降**: visibility GT 几乎全 1，predictor 只需猜 "全可见" 就有 83% accuracy
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1098:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1237:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:304:**上下文**: Phase 1 (33 个实验) 已充分探索了基于 ViTPose visibility 向量的所有方向。最佳训练端改进仅 +1.4%（GiLt+PCFC）。用户指示放弃 visibility 方向，转向纯 pose heatmap + mmpose 更鲁棒模型。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:584:- ViTPose visibility 向量不够可靠（AP 相关性仅 0.237）
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:585:- 中间层 visibility modulation 有害（破坏预训练空间结构），但这是 visibility 特有问题
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:588:- **关键结论**: 不要用 visibility 向量，用原始 pose 热图
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:926:   - 所有 visibility-dependent 训练方法失败 (VCSR, routing)
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:1460:experiments/exp109/design.md:66:   - 说明关键在 latent feature completion，而不是 visibility correction
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2112:experiments/decisions.md:1107:**上下文**: exp148 PCVT 和 exp151 PVAT 全部失败。训练集 95.8% 可见率使得所有 visibility-dependent 训练方法无效。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2114:experiments/decisions.md:1143:1. **exp148 PCVT**: 早期加速（ep30 +2.4 mAP），后期被基线追平并反超（ep100 -0.9 mAP）。3-view 训练的 1/3 主损失稀释 + 训练数据缺乏 visibility 多样性。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2276:experiments/decisions.md:3679:1. 确保 pose_data 在 lab4090 与 srvB(训练集 ground truth 源)完全一致,避免未来 Full Scaffold (OA-SD/PLBOA) 因 visibility 用 score proxy 出现微小精度漂移
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2894:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3971:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:203:- **pose-part + 只匹配互见部位：最成熟的轴**。PVPM (CVPR'20) 已有 visibility predictor + 只匹配可见部位；KPR (ECCV'24, SOLIDER/Swin) 是当前最强同款。我们的差异仅 **MaxSim**（ColBERT late-interaction 借来）替代固定 part-to-part 对齐——mechanism 小 delta，不是新问题定义。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2897:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:3975:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:268:- **新颖性裁决 + plateau 双确认**：novelty agent 的"路线2=打平/超SOTA"对单分支 pose-part-MaxSim 已**实质不可达**（~48 all-query vs 需 ≥62）。剩可走路线只有 **(1) 机制重组 LoRA↔visibility** 或 **(3) 问题 reframe（common-visible support / reliability-aware matching，CLAUDE.md 钦定方向）**。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2913:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4122:experiments/exp324b/design.md:19:- **数据流**：图 → 冻结 DINOv2-base dense tokens → 姿态锚定 5 部位池化 + per-part visibility（exp324 已实现）→ **轻量共享线性投影头** 768→512 + BNNeck → 全局特征 = 可见部位投影向量的 masked mean；测试用 mutually-visible part-MaxSim 出 distmat。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2918:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4209:experiments/exp324/design.md:15:frozen DINOv2-B dense patch tokens，按 pose 锚定成 5 个 body-part 表征（带 per-part visibility），跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 part-MaxSim，在**重遮挡子集**上**超过 holistic 基线**（DINO 全局 cosine 以及/或 exp255 holistic）——全程 training-free。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2929:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_ovli.txt:4304:experiments/results.md:1654:> post-PRCV「搬范式」#2 路线。frozen DINOv2-base（lab-3090-d, RTX 3090），全量 Occluded-Duke（2210 query × 17661 gallery，无后处理、无训练）。脚本 `scripts/exp324_dino.py`。输入 224W×448H → patch grid 32×16。keypoints 缩放到 grid → 每部位 3×3 窗均值池化成 5 个 part 向量 + per-part visibility，跨图只比 mutually-visible part 的 per-part cosine（part-MaxSim）。重遮挡子集 = query visibility_binary.sum()≤8（989/2210）。**training-free，不计入主表增益。**
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3227:experiments/exp108/design.md:17:3. 与 `exp107` 不同，duplicate-aware pruning 在 per-keypoint 层面才可能真正发挥作用，因为 duplicate detection 与 visibility/common-support 是同一层面的结构信息。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3456:experiments/exp324d/codex_review.md:12:- `bmm(pool_w, patch)` 与 `build_part_pose` cell 等价：同 part groups / visibility skip / (0,0) sentinel / rounded grid cell / 3×3 窗 / set-union / mean 权重。`r*GRID_W+c` 匹配 DINO patch row-major 顺序。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5549:./reassess/r_2.md:1263:reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3597:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5686:./reassess/r_2.md:5462:reassess/r_3.md:4768:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:471:- **为何非已关方向**: 与 visibility 加权**正交**(visibility 问"是否被遮挡"二值; burstiness 问"这个可见特征是否被过度计数"集内冗余统计)。一个 part 可完全可见且高 visibility 却 bursty(大块平躯干)——现有方法升权它, burstiness 说降权。非 completion(不重建)、非 scorer 微变体(改特征集聚合)、非 uncertainty(无 per-feature 置信)。**Novelty 已核: 无 occluded-ReID 做 burst-aware/democratic over part/patch 特征**(最近 cousin = Self-similarity guided probabilistic matching ESWA'23 是去噪/校验, 相反符号)。详见 memory [[burstiness-democratic-aggregation-bet]]。
